The paper products are of exceptional quality. The notebooks are sturdy, and the pages are smooth, making writing a pleasure. The ruled lines and the elegant design add a touch of sophistication to my note-taking. Additionally, the adhesive on the sticky notes is top-notch; they stick firmly without leaving any residue.

The highlighters and markers are true game-changers! The highlighters glide smoothly over the paper, without any smudging or bleeding through the pages. The markers are bold and vivid, making my color-coding and creative projects a breeze.

One of my favorite finds was the stylish pencil case. It's not only trendy but also highly functional, comfortably fitting all my writing essentials while protecting them from damage.

The delivery was prompt and everything arrived in perfect condition, thanks to the secure packaging. The customer service was also outstanding, addressing my queries with efficiency and courtesy.

In conclusion, these stationary products have elevated my writing and organizational experience. The attention to detail, quality, and broad selection of items make this purchase a true value for money. I highly recommend these products to anyone in need of high-quality stationary for personal or professional use. I will undoubtedly be a returning customer!

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: Reliable Stores is a small departmental store situated in the middle of Kalina market in Santa Cruz East a suburb of Mumbai.  Huge variety of stationery and toys and related day to day items. During the festival season they specialise in the items in demand for the season.  Lights and related fixtures for the festival of lights.  Trees and toys during December.  Helpful and courteous staff and value for money when you visit the store. Worth a visit.  Parking is always a problem as the road outside is congested.  Use public transport.
